findings.title: Guard the offset multiplication against overflow.
findings.rationale: If a caller supplies a sufficiently large positive n, the guard is bypassed and (n - 1) * s.rows can overflow int, returning an incorrect offset. Add an upper-bound or overflow check before the multiplication.
